chapters.3.meaning: One woman would rather lose the child than see him killed. Solomon recognizes her care.
chapters.6.meaning: Cedar walls, carved flowers, and separate rooms mark the temple. Its design sets worship apart.
chapters.7.lds: The older Church manual compares the bronze sea with baptism.
chapters.11.meaning: Solomon's choices weaken his kingdom. God promises most tribes to Jeroboam.
chapters.14.meaning: Jeroboam's wife seeks help for their sick child. Ahijah's warning reaches the whole royal family.
chapters.19.meaning: Elijah needs food and rest before his next task. God gives him help and new work.
chapters.20.meaning: Ahab wins two battles but spares Ben Hadad. A prophet warns him about that choice.
chapters.22.meaning: Most prophets promise Ahab victory. Micaiah describes a heavenly meeting that reveals their deception.
chapters.22.lds: The older Church manual reads the lying spirit as God allowing deception.
chapters.12.meaning: Rehoboam's threats divide the kingdom. Jeroboam then builds places of worship to keep people from Jerusalem.
chapters.21.meaning: Officials use false witnesses to kill Naboth. Ahab takes the inherited vineyard Naboth refused to sell.
people.solomon.meaning: He asks for wisdom and builds the temple. Later, his support for other gods divides the kingdom.
people.abishag.meaning: She cares for David in his old age. Adonijah's later request to marry her alarms Solomon.
people.judgment-women.meaning: Both women claim one child. One asks Solomon to spare the child's life.
people.pharaoh-daughter-solomon.meaning: Solomon's Egyptian wife receives her own house beside the royal buildings.
people.hiram-artisan.meaning: He brings skill in bronze work to the temple project.
people.shishak.meaning: Egypt's king takes treasures from the temple and royal house.
people.tahpenes.meaning: Egypt's queen has family ties to Hadad. Her sister marries him during his stay in Egypt.
people.maacah-queen.meaning: Asa removes her royal position after she makes an object for worship.
people.nadab.meaning: Jeroboam's son rules briefly before Baasha kills him and destroys his household.
people.baasha.meaning: He takes power by killing Nadab. A prophet later warns him about his own family's fall.
people.shemer.meaning: Omri buys his hill and builds Samaria there. The city's name recalls its former owner.
people.jezebel.meaning: She threatens Elijah and arranges false charges against Naboth.
people.zarephath-widow.meaning: She shares food during hunger. Later, she speaks to Elijah about her grief for her son.
people.joash-prince.meaning: Ahab places Micaiah under his care and Amon's care while the king goes to battle.
chapters.1.title: Two sons seek David's throne
chapters.16.title: Kings fall before Omri and Ahab rise
chapters.18.summary: Obadiah meets Elijah. Elijah asks Israel to choose between God and Baal. Fire answers his prayer. Baal's prophets are killed, and rain returns.
people.rehoboam.role: King whose harsh answer divides Israel
people.hazael.role: Future Syrian king named in God's instructions to Elijah
people.jehu-nimshi.role: Future Israelite king named in God's instructions to Elijah
